jsonld_raw.name: SEASONS MYRRH AND FIG SET
jsonld_raw.description: SEASONS MYRRH AND FIG SET. Inspired by the light, aromas, and slow pace of a summer in Greece. The cliffs overlooking the Aegean Sea and sun-drenched afternoons serve as the inspiration for this collection. The juicy sweetness of lychee adds a delicate brightness, while myrrh reveals a warm, sophisticated facet. Vanilla envelops the composition with creamy softness, transforming the space into a cozy and relaxing sanctuary. This set contains: Lychee & Lemongrass Parfum 30ml, Myrrh and Fig Scent Diffuser 90ml, Myrrh and Fig Scented Candle 75ml. A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.
